updates.title: Cancel or closing the clear-shifts question calls the change off
preconds: Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.

At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
↳ Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
↳ Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.

Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
↳ On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
↳ On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
↳ Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.

On the Schedule, give "Esther Howard" a shift on the work order tomorrow 8:00–12:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order > set the end time > save.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
Drag the card from Esther Howard's column into Ralph Edwards' column.
Drag the card into Ralph Edwards' column again and close the prompt with its close (X) button.
Drag the card into Ralph Edwards' column again and press Escape on the keyboard.
Drag the card into Ralph Edwards' column again and click an empty part of the page outside the prompt.
Hover the card, click More actions > Reassign lead technician, pick Ralph Edwards and confirm.
In the prompt click Cancel and read the screen.
Click Cancel in the Reassign lead technician dialog.
Open the work order and read Lead Technician, then open the Schedule for tomorrow.
Repeat steps 3 to 10 in Tech View.
results: After Cancel, after X, after Escape and after a click outside the prompt, the dragged card goes back to its place in Esther Howard's column, and no "Lead technician updated" message appears.
After Cancel from the dialog path you are back in the Reassign lead technician dialog with Ralph Edwards still chosen.
In the end nothing changed: Lead Technician is Esther Howard and her 8:00–12:00 shift is still on the Schedule.
updates.source: Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R30, read 8 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026 ("Cancel undoes the move"). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified. Escape and a click outside as ways of closing the prompt: the design system's dialog behaviour in the 8 Oct design export.
quotes: Cancel, or closing the prompt, calls the change off. A dragged card goes back to where it was; in the Reassign dialog the user is back in the dialog with their choice kept.

Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.

At least 2 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
↳ Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Ralph Edwards") and an email.
↳ Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.

Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
Create 3 Approved work orders for the case customer: (a) no lead and no line technician; (b) no lead, one line given to Ralph Edwards; (c) lead Esther Howard and no line technician.
steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
Turn line technicians on in Fields to display and read the field on each of the three cards.
Pick Tech View with Assigned Techs on and read the column for the three rows.
results: (a) is blank. (b) shows Ralph Edwards. (c) shows Esther Howard. So only 1 of the 3 is blank. A "-" in an empty cell counts as blank.
